name: pushpals-vscode-client
description: VS Code client for PushPals with local stack orchestration and live session chat.

pushpals.serverUrl.description: PushPals server base URL used by the VS Code client. Hostnames are coerced to 127.0.0.1 in local-only mode.

pushpals.workerDockerImage.description: Worker sandbox Docker image tag required by workerpals:only:docker.

pushpals.includeSourceControlManager.description: Also start source_control_manager:only:dev when starting the stack.

pushpals.autoStartStackOnActivate.description: Automatically start PushPals stack when this extension activates.

pushpals.cliCommand.description: Optional command or absolute path for the installed PushPals CLI used when the workspace is not a PushPals source checkout. Defaults to pushpals (or pushpals.cmd on Windows).

scripts.compile: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && bunx tsc -p .
